chars.NARRATOR: a Moroccan man aged 38 with short black hair, a neat short beard, wearing a dark green hoodie and light grey jogging trousers
chars.EXWIFE: a Moroccan woman aged 33 with long dark wavy hair in a loose low ponytail, wearing a burgundy long-sleeve house dress
chars.NEIGHBOUR: a handsome Moroccan man aged 27 with styled black hair and a thin moustache, wearing a white tank top and black track pants with white side stripes
chars.FATHER: a Moroccan man aged 65 with grey hair and grey moustache, wearing a beige djellaba and brown leather babouche slippers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Evening inside a modest Moroccan living room, seen from behind NARRATOR's shoulder: EXWIFE stands facing him with tears running down her face, hands pressed together pleading, begging forgiveness, head-to-waist framing, her face clearly visible in the upper-middle of the frame; NARRATOR stands stiff and cold, seen from behind. Warm lamp light, low sedari sofas in the background.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: EXWIFE sits on the edge of a Moroccan sedari sofa holding a small baby wrapped in a white blanket, looking down at the baby with a desperate, crying face, shoulders slumped; evening lamp light, calm plain wall behind.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room, EXWIFE has stepped close to NARRATOR and grabs his sleeve, crying, eyes pleading; NARRATOR looks away with a hard, hurt expression, arms crossed; both faces visible, medium shot.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR calmly points toward the open front door of the house with a cold, decided face, while EXWIFE stands frozen in surprise, tears on her cheeks; modest Moroccan hallway with tiles, medium shot.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: At the front door of a Moroccan house at night, NARRATOR shakes hands respectfully with FATHER on the doorstep and starts closing the wooden door; FATHER has a sad, ashamed face; warm light from inside, dark quiet street outside.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits alone on a sedari sofa in a dim Moroccan living room at night, elbows on knees, hands on his face, tears, heartbroken; a single lamp on, empty room around him.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Daytime, NARRATOR walks calmly up the wide stone steps of a Moroccan courthouse in Casablanca holding a brown paper folder, determined, dignified expression; Moroccan flag and arches in the background.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Morning in a quiet Moroccan street, EXWIFE walks alone carrying the small baby in a white blanket against her chest, tired but calm face, soft sunrise light, whitewashed walls and blue doors.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR stands by a window at dusk looking down thoughtfully at a small baby asleep in a white crib in the foreground, his face sad and gentle; soft warm light, calm Moroccan room.
